Press release dated 2026-05-15 says he and another member introduced the Kimberly Vaughan Firearm Safe Storage Act (H.R. 8619, 119th Congress): dealers, makers and importers would give written safe-storage information and a storage device with each firearm sold; Justice Department best practices; storage-device grants; a tax credit. Date is the release date, not the filing date.
subjects: guns sold with a storage device

findings.passage: “Safe firearm storage is one of the simplest and most effective ways to prevent gun violence, suicides, accidental shootings, and to keep stolen weapons from ending up in the wrong hands.”
findings.note: Quote from his official release on his safe-storage bill.

findings.passage: We must keep fighting for solutions that keep guns away from those who seek to do harm and keep our students safe.
findings.note: Statement after two Houston-area students were killed in shootings; calls for solutions that keep guns from people who would harm others; no specific bill named.

findings.note: Statement issued in his office's name on his support for keeping guns from domestic abusers; says he is on the House Gun Violence Prevention Task Force.
